subject: Handoff: CobaltMed onboarding — scope, timeline, and owners
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>; Samuel Park <samuel.park@cobaltmed.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@cobaltmed.com>
Cc: procurement@cobaltmed.com
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Handoff: CobaltMed onboarding — scope, timeline, and owners

Hi team — looping everyone in to move CobaltMed from signed to kickoff. Quick context up top and then the things we need from CS/ops to get a clean SOW and kickoff scheduled.

Deal snapshot
- Account: CobaltMed (health-tech analytics)
- ARR: $420k committed first-year (platform + support)
- Committed go-live: 2029-06-14 (customer target)
- Contract: fully executed; procurement will issue PO (procurement@cobaltmed.com) — expected next week per Samuel.

Technical & delivery highlights
- Integration: initial data ingest via SFTP (customer-managed bucket). 2 pipelines: nightly bulk + daily delta.
- Residency: US-only (HIPAA). Customer requires SOC2 attestation on our private deployment; they prefer Private (VPC) but are open to Dedicated if we can meet encryption/KMS controls.
- Expected usage: ~120M tokens/month steady state; peak concurrency ~12 QPS for embedding+chat endpoints.
- Models: plan to start on rdx-large (quantized) for cost; evaluate upgrade to rdx-xl in Q3 if latency SLA met.

Open items for CS / Implementation team
1) Owner assignment: who will be the primary CS owner and the implementation PM? 2) Security touchpoint: who owns SOC2 evidence collection & KMS setup? 3) Pre-kick checklist: please review attached draft SOW and kickoff agenda and send back any edits by EOD Mon 5/13.

Attachments (first pass)
- CobaltMed_SOW_v1.pdf (draft, includes milestones and acceptance criteria)
- CobaltMed_Kickoff_Agenda.docx (30/60/90 view)
- pricing_summary.xlsx (final pricing table from legal)

Risks / notes
- Procurement timeline is the gating item for infra provisioning. If PO slips beyond 5/17 we risk missing the 6/14 target.
- Customer will require a short technical architecture review during week of 5/20.

Ask: Monica / Karthik / Tessa — can you confirm owners and whether Private (VPC) is required or Dedicated is acceptable? If you prefer, propose a kickoff slot and I’ll coordinate with the customer.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri.yom@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Thanks for the context, Priyom — big picture looks good. A few clarifying Qs before we lock owners and kickoff: 

- Usage numbers: is 120M tokens/month the committed minimum in the contract or an expected run-rate? We need committed minimums for sizing Dedicated pools.
- Concurrency: can you confirm the expected distribution across endpoints (chat vs embeddings vs batch)? That will affect autoscaling config.
- Data ingest: any PII-specific fields in the payloads we should mark for redaction?

Draft owner plan (provisional)
- CS Lead: Monica Patel (I will be primary for post-sign success and adoption)
- Implementation PM: Tessa Morgan (owner for sprint plan and customer coordination)
- Solutions Eng: Karthik Iyer (technical design, infra sizing, and architecture reviews)

If that looks good, I’ll send a kickoff invite with 3 time options and attach our pre-kick checklist. Also need to confirm whether CobaltMed requires Private (VPC) for the first wave — Priyom, you mentioned they prefer it. If they absolutely require Private we’ll engage Security for KMS/SOC2 evidence flows and update the SOW timelines.

Monica
Monica Patel | Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>; Samuel Park <samuel.park@cobaltmed.com>, Emma Liu <emma.liu@cobaltmed.com>
Date: Sat, 11 May 2029 08:45:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Handoff: CobaltMed onboarding — scope, timeline, and owners

Monica — thanks, that owner plan works for the customer. Quick answers inline and I’ve attached the items you asked for.

- 120M tokens/month: expected steady-state run-rate; contract has 80M committed first-year minimum (see pricing_summary.xlsx, tab "Commitments"). We should size for burst capacity but base infra on 80M.
- Distribution: ~60% chat, 35% embeddings, 5% batch scoring. Peak concurrency mostly for chat (10-12 QPS), embeddings spikes are short-lived.
- PII: customer has PHI in some payloads (patient IDs, limited notes). They will do de-identification in upstream ETL but want our standard redaction flag enabled until SOC2 is completed.

Procurement note: Samuel indicated procurement will route PO to us by EOD 5/16; copy sent to procurement@cobaltmed.com.

Attachments included
- CobaltMed_SOW_v1.pdf (attached)
- CobaltMed_Kickoff_Agenda.docx (attached)
- pricing_summary.xlsx (attached)

Monica — please start the security ticket for SOC2 evidence collection if we decide on Private. If we run Dedicated initially, we can still meet most controls but will need customer sign-off on KMS approach.

Happy to jump on a quick sync if useful.

Cheers,
Priyom

- CS Lead: Monica Patel (primary customer success owner)
- Implementation PM: Tessa Morgan (sprint and deliverable owner)
- Solutions Eng: Karthik Iyer (technical design & architecture review)

We need to lock one of these kickoff options — each invite will be ~60 minutes and include us + 3 CobaltMed SMEs: product, security, and infra.

Kickoff options (US PT):
- Tue, 2029-05-21 10:00 - 11:00 PT
- Wed, 2029-05-22 13:00 - 14:00 PT
- Thu, 2029-05-23 08:00 - 09:00 PT

Pre-kick checklist (short)
- Customer to confirm PO/PO date (procurement@cobaltmed.com)
- Provide SFTP hostname and sample file (or mock dataset)
- Confirm PII fields / redaction rules (data owner)
- Confirm whether Private (VPC) is a hard requirement — if yes, security will need 5 business days to validate KMS/HSM integration before provisioning

Next steps: Monica/Tessa, once the customer confirms a slot I’ll produce a technical intake doc and schedule the architecture review for week of 5/20.
